title: Engagement of Independent Engineer for the project - Development of tourism at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse on PPP basis.
summary: Corrigendum to a tender engaging an Independent Engineer for the PPP tourism development project at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, adding TNIDB Panel no. 23 consultants to the eligibility.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Mahabalipuram Lighthouse
sites.work: Independent Engineer for PPP tourism development project

scope.item: Engagement of Independent Engineer for the project - Development of tourism at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse on PPP basis

eligibility: As amended: bidder shall have undertaken eligible assignments with empaneled consultants of the Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Board under Panel no. 10 & Panel no. 23, with experience and expertise in engineering consultancy as Independent Engineer for PPP projects

corrigenda.change: Eligibility/pre-qualification: 'Panel no. 10' read as 'Panel no. 10 & Panel no. 23' of Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Board empaneled consultants

notes: Only the corrigendum is attached; no NIT, cost, EMD or dates. This corrigendum names the 'Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Board' whereas the later corrigendum (nid 1659, 04-07-2024) names 'Tamil Nadu Infrastructure Development Board' and removes the empanelment requirement altogether.
